normal: Let A,B,C be coordinates at the first three one-based face indices. Compute u=C-B in x/y/z order, then v=A-B in x/y/z order.
nx=u.y*v.z-u.z*v.y; ny=u.z*v.x-u.x*v.z; nz=u.x*v.y-u.y*v.x, stored in x/y/z order.
m=sqrt((nx*nx+ny*ny)+nz*nz). If m!=0 divide nx,ny,nz by m separately and in order. Do not compare triangle area to1e-6 before normalization.
Copy resulting normal and compute sqrt((nx*nx+ny*ny)+nz*nz) again through239a30->2399b0->484644. For finite results require >=1e-6 before grouping.
